description: Hand-written question/answer pairs grounded in the TechCorp document corpus, used to measure retrieval (recall@k) and answer quality (LLM-as-judge). 'answerable: false' items are out-of-scope and exist to verify the system refuses / says 'I don't know' instead of hallucinating. relevant_keywords must co-occur within a single source chunk.

schema.question: user question
schema.source: source filename the answer comes from
schema.page: page number where the supporting text lives (null for markdown docs / unanswerable)
schema.relevant_keywords: distinctive terms that MUST appear together in a correctly retrieved chunk; used for retrieval hit-rate scoring
schema.answerable: true if the corpus contains the answer, false if it does not

questions.question: What are the standard work hours at TechCorp?
questions.expected_answer: Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM EST.

questions.question: On which days are employees allowed to work remotely?
questions.expected_answer: Tuesdays and Thursdays, with additional flexibility possible if approved by a department manager.

questions.question: How many paid time off days do employees get per year?
questions.expected_answer: 20 days of paid time off per calendar year.

questions.question: How many unused PTO days can be carried over to the next year?
questions.expected_answer: Up to five days of unused PTO may be carried forward into the following year.

questions.question: What is the annual learning and development budget?
questions.expected_answer: $1,200 per year, usable for online courses, certifications, technical books, conferences, and workshops.

questions.question: What equipment and home office stipend do engineers receive?
questions.expected_answer: Engineers receive a MacBook Pro and a $500 home office stipend.

questions.question: How often are performance reviews conducted?
questions.expected_answer: Performance reviews are conducted twice annually, with continuous feedback possible throughout the year.

questions.question: What is the primary communication platform at TechCorp?
questions.expected_answer: Slack is the primary communication platform used within TechCorp.

questions.question: How are employees paid and on what schedule?
questions.expected_answer: Employees are paid bi-weekly through direct deposit.

questions.question: What security practices are employees required to follow?
questions.expected_answer: Employees must use strong passwords, enable multi-factor authentication on approved systems, keep confidential information within authorized channels, and report any suspected security incident, phishing attempt, or data breach immediately to the Information Security team.

questions.question: Within how many days must expense reports be submitted, and what must they include?
questions.expected_answer: Expense reports must be submitted within 10 business days, include valid receipts, and clearly describe the business purpose.

questions.question: What is required before an employee can travel for business?
questions.expected_answer: Business travel must receive prior approval from the employee's manager, and employees should use cost-effective, company-approved booking platforms.

questions.question: What types of insurance are eligible employees offered?
questions.expected_answer: Eligible employees receive medical, dental, and vision insurance plans, plus wellness and mental health support programs.

questions.question: What must an employee do when their employment is terminated?
questions.expected_answer: They must return all company-owned equipment, documents, and confidential materials; system access may be revoked immediately, and confidentiality obligations continue after employment ends.

questions.question: How far in advance should vacation requests be submitted?
questions.expected_answer: Vacation requests should be submitted at least two weeks in advance whenever possible.

questions.question: On what criteria are employees evaluated during performance reviews?
questions.expected_answer: Technical expertise, collaboration and teamwork, communication effectiveness, leadership contributions, problem-solving capabilities, and impact on business objectives.

questions.question: What should an employee do if they notice a workplace hazard or injury?
questions.expected_answer: Immediately report workplace hazards, injuries, unsafe conditions, or emergencies to Human Resources or Facilities.

questions.question: What are the rules around social media and public communication?
questions.expected_answer: Employees should not share confidential information publicly, must communicate professionally when representing TechCorp, and public statements on behalf of the company require appropriate authorization.

questions.question: Is TechCorp an equal opportunity employer, and what is its stance on discrimination?
questions.expected_answer: Yes. TechCorp is an equal opportunity employer; discrimination based on race, religion, gender, disability, age, or any protected characteristic is strictly prohibited.

questions.question: What requirements must remote employees meet while working from home?
questions.expected_answer: They must maintain reliable internet, be available during core collaboration hours, follow all security and confidentiality guidelines, and maintain professional conduct in virtual meetings.

questions.question: If I work remotely on Wednesday and need a new laptop, what does the handbook say I am entitled to and is Wednesday an allowed remote day?
questions.expected_answer: Engineers are provided a MacBook Pro and a $500 home office stipend, but remote work is only allowed on Tuesdays and Thursdays by default, so Wednesday is not a standard remote day unless a manager approves additional flexibility.

questions.question: What is TechCorp's 401(k) matching contribution policy?
questions.expected_answer: TechCorp matches 100% of employee contributions up to 4% of the employee's annual salary. The company match vests after 2 years of continuous service, while employee contributions are always fully vested.

questions.question: How many paid sick days do employees receive per year?
questions.expected_answer: Employees receive 10 paid sick days per calendar year, separate from PTO.

questions.question: What is the vesting schedule for RSU stock grants?
questions.expected_answer: RSU grants vest over a 4-year period with a 1-year cliff: 25% vests after the first year, and the remaining 75% vests in equal quarterly installments over the following three years.

questions.question: Who is the CEO of TechCorp?
questions.expected_answer: Jordan Avery is the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) and co-founded TechCorp in 2015.

questions.question: When was TechCorp founded and where is it headquartered?
questions.expected_answer: TechCorp was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Austin, Texas.

questions.question: Who is the Chief Technology Officer of TechCorp?
questions.expected_answer: Morgan Lee is the Chief Technology Officer (CTO), overseeing engineering, security, and infrastructure.

questions.question: When is the annual benefits open enrollment period?
questions.expected_answer: Open enrollment runs from November 1 through November 30 each year.

questions.question: How much does TechCorp contribute to an eligible employee's HSA?
questions.expected_answer: TechCorp contributes $750 per year to each eligible employee's Health Savings Account (HSA).

questions.question: How much paid parental leave do primary and secondary caregivers receive?
questions.expected_answer: 12 weeks of paid leave for the primary caregiver and 6 weeks for the secondary caregiver, available after 6 months of employment.

questions.question: What medical plan tiers does TechCorp offer?
questions.expected_answer: Three tiers: Basic, Standard (PPO), and Premium (PPO).

questions.question: What are the password requirements at TechCorp?
questions.expected_answer: Passwords must be at least 14 characters, mix character types, be changed at least every 90 days, and never be reused across personal and company accounts.

questions.question: How quickly must a security incident be reported?
questions.expected_answer: Security incidents must be reported to the Information Security team within 1 hour of discovery.

questions.question: What password manager does TechCorp provide?
questions.expected_answer: TechCorp provides every employee with a 1Password password manager license.

questions.question: What are the four data classification levels?
questions.expected_answer: Public, Internal, Confidential, and Restricted.

questions.question: How often are company laptops refreshed?
questions.expected_answer: Company laptops are refreshed every 3 years, or sooner if a device fails or no longer meets performance requirements.

questions.question: How much can an employee spend on additional peripherals and accessories?
questions.expected_answer: Up to a total of $2,000 with manager approval; purchases above that cap require director-level approval.

questions.question: What are the meal per diem amounts for domestic and international travel?
questions.expected_answer: $75 per day for domestic travel and $100 per day for international travel.

questions.question: What is the mileage reimbursement rate for using a personal vehicle?
questions.expected_answer: $0.67 per mile for approved business travel.

questions.question: How long is the onboarding buddy program?
questions.expected_answer: Every new employee is paired with an onboarding buddy for their first 90 days.

questions.question: Which trainings must new employees complete in their first week?
questions.expected_answer: Security Awareness Training, Code of Conduct Training, and Anti-Harassment Training, all within the first week.

questions.question: What is the limit on gifts an employee can accept from a vendor?
questions.expected_answer: Employees may not accept gifts worth more than $100 from any vendor, customer, or business partner.

questions.question: How quickly must a SEV1 incident be acknowledged?
questions.expected_answer: A SEV1 (critical) incident requires acknowledgement within 15 minutes and an immediate response.

questions.question: What is TechCorp's sabbatical leave policy?
questions.expected_answer: The corpus does not mention any sabbatical leave policy.

questions.question: Does TechCorp offer relocation assistance or a relocation bonus?
questions.expected_answer: The corpus does not mention relocation assistance or any relocation bonus.

questions.question: Will TechCorp reimburse tuition for a university degree program?
questions.expected_answer: The corpus does not mention tuition reimbursement for degree programs; the learning and development budget covers courses, certifications, books, conferences, and workshops, not degrees.

questions.question: Does TechCorp reimburse gym or fitness membership fees?
questions.expected_answer: The corpus does not mention gym or fitness membership reimbursement, though it does offer wellness support programs.
